senses.gloss: m. (preced., with format. ל; cmp. כַּרְמֶל &c.) scalp (used as a charm in battle).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 11b:3">Ab. Zar. 11ᵇ</cite> (describing a sort of secular game) <he>אחת לשבעים … קַרְקִיפְלוֹ של וכ׳</he> once in seventy years they make a well man ride on a lame man and dress him in the garments of Adam and place on his head the scalp of R. Ishmael &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 123a:3">Ḥull. 123ᵃ</cite> <he>קרְקֵפְלוֹ של ו׳ וכ׳</he> R. Ishmael’s scalp was put on the head of kings (as a charm.). Pl. <he>קַרְקַפְלִין</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 123a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אין לך לגיון  … וכ׳</he> there is not a Roman legion that does not carry with it several scalps; <cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 8:16">Tosef. ib. VIII, 16</cite>.
